summary_en: Cancellation of treasury shares suspended. Company determined that maintaining flexibility for capital allocation, including potential use for warrant exercise settlements, better serves long-term enterprise value than proceeding with scheduled cancellation.
title_en: Notice of Change in Disclosure – Suspension of Treasury Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: i-mobile Co., Ltd. announced the suspension of treasury share cancellation on August 24, 2026. The company had previously resolved (June 11, 2025) to acquire and cancel treasury shares, with the specific quantity and cancellation date to be determined. Following a reassessment of treasury share deployment strategy, the company determined that maintaining flexibility to apply treasury shares toward settlement of warrant exercises—and preserving optionality for dynamic capital allocation—better serves long-term enterprise value creation than proceeding with cancellation. The company simultaneously issued warrants (third-party allocation, performance-linked, and tax-qualified stock options) for which treasury shares may be applied upon exercise. A prior cancellation decision from June 11, 2026 is also being suspended for the same reason.
